codeSamples.code:
<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/requests/%7BrequestId%7D/messages';
$ch = curl_init();

$baseUrl =  $baseUrl . '?AccountReference=String&MessageId=String&ConversationId=String&Status=String&Reason=String&Msisdn=String&DestinationCode=String&Originator=String&RequestName=String&Channel=String&MessageType=String&Source=String&Route=String&StartTime=String&EndTime=String&PageSize=Integer&PageNo=Integer&SortOrder=String&SortBy=String&RetrieveMessageBody=Boolean&Direction=String&SubmittedBy=String&RcsType=String';

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'AccountReference' => 'your-AccountReference-header-here',
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}
?>

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint returns all messages associated with a single request. This can be filtered based on channel, message type, status and more.

Before you start using this endpoint, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites.

sections.title: Headers & parameters
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderDescription
X-Api-KeyAPI Key value
AccountReferenceYour Spryng Account reference - e.g. SPNL0000000

Example request header:
GET https://api.spryng.nl/v2/requests/{requestId}/messages
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'AccountReference: SPNL0000000'

Query parameters

The below parameters are available as optional filters to your request. They should be provided as a query within the request path.

PropertyTypeDescription
AccountReferenceArrayThe list of account references provided as an array
MessageIdStringFilter by a message id
StatusStringStatus of the requested messages. Enum e.g. Delivered | Received | Failed | In Progress
ReasonStringFailure reason provided as an enum e.g. Delivered | DestinationNotAllowed | DisallowedContent | EdgeFailed | EdgeSubmitted | FailedToRoute | Inbound | MessagePartCountExceeded | MsisdnInvalid | OptedOut | OutsideBusinessHours | PartiallyDelivered | senderIdInvalid | SendingLimitExceeded | Unprocessable | WithinQuietHours
MsisdnStringThe phone number that received the outbound message or the phone number that sent the inbound message. Must use international format e.g. 447xxxxxxxxx. This lets you filter for all messages from and to an MSISDN
DestinationCodeStringNullable. 2-letter ISO3166 destination code for the destination of the message e.g. Destination sent to/ or destination received from
OriginatorStringThe "from" value for outbound messages or the "to" value for inbound messages. This lets you filter for all messages from and to an originator such as a VMN or Shortcode or senderId
RequestNameStringNullable. Optional name of the request
ChannelStringChannel the message was sent via. Enum e.g. SMS
MessageTypeStringEnum e.g. Unknown | MarketingAndResearch | NotificationsAndReminders | AuthenticationAndSecurity | PaymentsAndCollections | InternalOperations | CustomerSupport | Conversational
SourceStringWhich product area provided the message
StartTimedateTimeFilter messages where submittedAt is greater than or equal to startTime
EndTimedateTimeFilter messages where submittedAt is less than or equal to endTime
PageSizeIntegerPagination required for the response. Allow 1-1000. Default = 1
PageNoIntegerNumber of pages for the response. Allow 1+. Default = 1
SortOrderQueryDefines sorting order for the results. Enum e.g. Asc/ Desc. Default = Desc
SortByQueryDefines sorting requirements for the results Enum e.g. Status | submittedAt | lastupdateTimestamp | channel | messageType | source | requestName. Default = submittedAt
RetrieveMessageBodyBooleanProvide if message body is required within the response. Default = TRUE
DirectionQueryEnum e.g. Outbound/ Inbound

sections.content:
